breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The agent repeated the exact error from the incomplete prompt: it replaced the spatially varying area A(x) with the arithmetic mean Ā = 350 mm² and computed δ = P·L/(E·Ā) ≈ 0.343 mm. The ground truth requires evaluating the actual integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx, which yields δ = (P·L)/(A0·E·k)·ln(1+k) ≈ 0.353 mm. Since 1/A(x) is nonlinear, the mean of A(x) does not equal the harmonic mean needed for the integral, and treating the arithmetic-mean substitution as exact is incorrect. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
